tag: 簡報開場：嬰兒推車與汽座設計介紹

level.why: 口語開場白，句子短而清楚，主要使用 walk you through、focus on、looking forward to 等常見簡報用語；字彙以設計與產品相關的基礎商務詞為主。

passage:
Thank you, Miranda.

Good morning, everyone. It's a pleasure to meet you all in person.

I'm Boyd, an industrial designer.

Today, I'll walk you through the design thinking behind three strollers and one car seat. I'll highlight the key features, demonstrate how they work, and explain the thinking behind each design.

Some of you may have already seen the samples, so I'll focus on the design concepts, key functions, and the ideas behind them.

I'm looking forward to sharing our ideas with you and hearing your thoughts and feedback.

With that, let's get started with our first stroller.
zh:
謝謝你，Miranda。

各位早安，很榮幸能與大家當面見面。

我是 Boyd，是一位工業設計師。

今天我會帶各位了解三款嬰兒推車和一款汽車安全座椅背後的設計思維。我會強調主要特色、示範它們如何運作，並說明每一款設計背後的想法。

各位當中有些人可能已經看過樣品，所以我會著重在設計概念、主要功能，以及這些設計背後的想法。

我很期待與各位分享我們的想法，也期待聽到大家的意見與回饋。

那麼，我們就從第一款推車開始吧。

vocab.col: walk you through the process / walk you through the steps
vocab.zh: 逐步向你說明、帶你了解

vocab.col: highlight the benefits / highlight key points
demonstrate a product / demonstrate how it works
look forward to meeting / look forward to hearing

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the speaker's talk?
opts: To announce a recall of several strollers
To introduce the design ideas behind several baby products
To ask the audience to buy the samples
To report last quarter's sales results
why: 文中沒有提到任何產品召回。
正解：講者說要帶大家了解三款推車與一款汽座背後的設計思維，並說明各項設計的想法。
講者只提到有些人看過樣品，並沒有要求聽眾購買。
文中沒有報告任何銷售成果。

questions.q: What does the speaker say he will focus on?
opts: The design concepts and key functions
why: 講者沒有提到價格或銷售計畫。
講者沒有談到製造時程。
正解：因為有些人已看過樣品，講者表示會著重在設計概念、主要功能與背後的想法。

questions.q: Before the launch, the designer will ______ how the new folding system works.
why: 正解：助動詞 will 後面要接原形動詞，demonstrate 表示「示範」。
demonstration 是名詞，不能直接接在 will 後面當動詞。
demonstrative 是形容詞，無法接 how 子句當受詞。
demonstrating 是動名詞／現在分詞，不能接在 will 後面。

questions.q: We are looking forward to ______ your feedback on the new design.
why: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面不能接原形動詞 receive。
received 是過去式／過去分詞，文法與語意都不符。
正解：look forward to 後面要接動名詞，所以用 receiving。
to 已經在 looking forward to 裡，再加 to receive 會重複且文法錯誤。

presentation_phrases.usage: 被主持人介紹後，開口前的第一句致謝

presentation_phrases.phrase: It's a pleasure to meet you all.
presentation_phrases.usage: 與客戶或合作夥伴初次見面的開場問候
說明簡報架構或產品設計流程
說明本次簡報的聚焦範圍

presentation_phrases.phrase: Some of you may have already seen ...
presentation_phrases.meaning: 各位當中有些人可能已經看過……
presentation_phrases.usage: 說明哪些內容會簡略帶過

presentation_phrases.phrase: I'm looking forward to hearing your feedback.
presentation_phrases.meaning: 我期待聽到各位的意見。

presentation_phrases.usage: 結束開場、進入正題的轉場句
